blocks.heading: WELCOME TO THE LABYRINTH
blocks.body: The comic follows Estafos and Suraya, two strangers trapped on a mysterious planet and pulled toward the same unanswered question. I wrote and designed the 12 pages, standardized the generated source material, assembled the layouts in Figma, animated panels in Rive and wired the reader’s state machine and JavaScript progression. The result sits between a comic, a motion piece and a small interactive experience.
